subject: bug: width parameter in sliderInput does nothing (possibly others too)

messages.author: 2e1c7278db3b434e
messages.subject: bug: width parameter in sliderInput does nothing (possibly others too)
parts:
I tried to change the 'width' parameter of a sliderInput, only to find that it did nothing.
Investigating the code showed me why; width is never used!
Probably remove this parameter from the documentation.
I used this workaround 

gsub('form-group shiny-input-container"',
          'form-group shiny-input-container" style="width: 100%;"',
           sliderInput("barNum",
           label="Number of Bins",
           min=8,max=60,value=35))
